verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack mentions OpenTelemetry or OTLP. The only relevant evidence is a community report: a team switched to the OpenTelemetry agent and Datadog did display those traces, but poorly, with everything labeled io.opentelemetry.something. That suggests Datadog accepts OTel-instrumented traces, with readability limitations. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of OTLP trace ingestion (endpoints or Collector/Agent configuration), explicit confirmation that the OTLP wire protocol is supported, evidence of sending or exporting traces out over OTLP, and well-mapped display of OTel span attributes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: One team switched from the Datadog agent to the OpenTelemetry agent. They found Datadog the worst commercial provider at showing those traces
